name: chonk
description: Tells you when your Claude Code session has gotten too big, and offers a handoff to a fresh one.

nudge_at.title: First nudge at (tokens)
nudge_at.description: Cumulative session tokens before the first wrap-up suggestion. Default 350000 (~p99 of a real 1145-session sample). Lower it if you never see a nudge; raise it if you get one too early.

rearm_every.title: Re-arm every (tokens)
rearm_every.description: How much further growth before chonk speaks up again. Default 250000, so a long session gets reminded at 600K / 850K / 1.1M rather than once and never again.
